noncompensatory_entry_gates.rule: An exact executable code/configuration/parameter hash binding to the same frozen M1-pass candidate must exist.
At least 3 independently certified public/development Night-1 personalized models for the exact candidate must be available before any Phase2B outcome access.
The exact executable candidate must have M1_PASS, VERIFIED, MATERIAL_DISAGREEMENT=false, and matching hashes.
Sham, leave-one-subject-out matched non-personalized, and deterministic cyclic wrong-subject comparators must all be executable for every included subject.
Synthetic draws, nominal bench variants, labels, or simulated pseudo-subjects cannot contribute to the formal subject denominator.

current_campaign_decision.reason: Entry gates A0-A3 are not estimable under the certified current inputs. The target ranking algorithm is therefore not entered.

eligibility_filter: Target has valid complete Phase2A Level A evidence with at least 30 paired seed-draw blocks.
Target meets its registered practical margin and simultaneous uncertainty threshold.
Target passes its exact level_a_shape_consistency rule in at least 4 of 6 draws; each draw requires the frozen target-specific metric/order/mapping/adjacency rule and missing draws fail.
At least 95 percent of prescribed runs are stable.

For every dependent Level-A and verifier condition and both SO/SPINDLE event types, RESCALE_ONLY_EVENT_VETO_V5 is valid and estimable and neither HARD_VETO_RESCALE_ONLY nor veto-equivalent INVALID fires.
No other target-specific or global off-target hard veto fires.
Independent verifier status is VERIFIED and MATERIAL_DISAGREEMENT=false.
Target grade is C or better under the registered A/B/C/D/F definitions.
T8 is excluded because it is prospectively exploratory in Candidate V5.

score_components.margin_slack: Let each target requirement be its F_TARGET_DECISIONS normalized slack (estimate-threshold for lower requirements, threshold-estimate for upper requirements) divided by the positive practical-margin magnitude. Take the minimum simultaneous lower bound across that target's required components, clamp to [0,3].
score_components.reproducibility: fraction of valid paired blocks with target-oriented effect in the registered direction
score_components.specificity: Require all 16 cross-target members in the policy row estimable. specificity=max(0,1-min(1,max_{j!=i} simultaneous UCB(A_i,j))); any hard veto or missing member makes the target ineligible.
score_components.stability: fraction of prescribed runs passing all stability rules

deterministic_ranking_algorithm_if_all_e.score_formula: score=0.35*(margin_slack/3)+0.25*reproducibility+0.20*specificity+0.15*stability+0.05*mechanistic_directness, evaluated in IEEE-754 float64 without rounding.
sort_keys: lower simultaneous confidence-bound margin slack descending
deterministic_ranking_algorithm_if_all_e.selection: Take the first min(3,number_eligible) targets after sorting; do not fill unused slots.
deterministic_ranking_algorithm_if_all_e.policy_freeze: For the all-target specificity matrix, use the exact Level-A worker policy_objects: T1's five-frequency mapping, T7's eight-phase mapping, and one Level-A condition for every other target. Conditional Level-B policy optimization is separate and cannot alter the 8x8 rows. Missing scores and exact ties follow the frozen rules; evaluation uses disjoint verifier seeds.
deterministic_ranking_algorithm_if_all_e.level_b_run_constraint: For a selected diagnostic set let n25 count T1,T2,T3,T4,T5,T8 and n20 count T6,T7. Execute exactly 12*(25*n25+20*n20) Level-B run identities, n25+n20<=3, maximum 900. Policy aggregation adds zero runs.
deterministic_ranking_algorithm_if_all_e.rescale_event_veto_rule: The veto is deterministic, nonmultiplicity, and evaluated before ranking. HARD_VETO_RESCALE_ONLY or INVALID excludes the target; NOT_ESTIMABLE excludes the target without being coerced to false. No favorable score, simultaneous band, or Holm result can override it.

required_new_version_for_future_eligibil.condition: A new exact governance-approved release supplies at least 3 eligible public/development Night-1 models and an exact same-candidate executable/hash binding before relevant outcomes are visible.
required_new_version_for_future_eligibil.action: Create and independently audit a new protocol version; Candidate V5 remains NOT_ESTIMABLE and its empty advancement decision remains immutable.

level_b_diagnostic_selection.scope: This is diagnostic Level-B selection only and cannot change current formal Phase2B NOT_ESTIMABLE.
level_b_diagnostic_selection.eligibility_and_order: phase2_protocol.json#phase2a/conditional_level_b, including the exact target-specific >=4/6 Level-A shape prerequisite
level_b_diagnostic_selection.T4_policy_and_verifier_rule: All three positive Level-A worker candidates, all ten positive Level-B candidates, and all three possible selected verifier candidates must resolve to their exact context row; nonformal rows remain diagnostic and cannot alter F_TARGET_DECISIONS.
level_b_diagnostic_selection.cross_target_independence: All eight 8x8 row policies are frozen from Level A before conditional Level B; no Level-B selection or result changes formal ranking specificity.
level_b_diagnostic_selection.verifier_runs: The all-target 8x8 matrix uses 456 unique verifier runs in the separate 50 CPU-hour reserve.
level_b_diagnostic_selection.rescale_event_veto: Every executed Level-B cell and launched verifier condition is subject to the identical V5 rescale-only SO/SPINDLE diagnostic; a missing diagnostic cannot enter selection and a hard/invalid diagnostic is ineligible.
